text.en: The public starting point for discovering Jam Tracks Hub tools, featured tracks, releases, and the site's purpose.
text.zhTW: 探索 Jam Tracks Hub 工具、精選音軌、最新發布與網站目的的公開起點。

text.en: The Homepage combines the brand hero, tool discovery, featured audio, latest releases, and About content. About remains a section of index.html rather than a separate product page.
text.zhTW: 首頁整合品牌主視覺、工具探索、精選音訊、最新發布與關於內容。「關於」仍是 index.html 的區段，而非獨立產品頁。

text.en: The page is the site's primary discovery surface for backing tracks and guitar tools.
text.zhTW: 此頁是網站探索伴奏音軌與吉他工具的主要介面。

text.en: The current hierarchy supports a visitor moving from brand context to a chosen tool or recent track without first understanding the full site map.
text.zhTW: 從目前層級回溯可見，訪客可從品牌脈絡前往選定工具或近期音軌，不需先理解完整網站地圖。

text.en: The initial Render deployment established the Homepage, its About section, Tracks access, Chord Progressions access, and the first site foundation.
text.zhTW: 最初 Render 部署建立首頁、關於區、音軌入口、和弦進行入口與第一版網站基礎。

text.en: Brand entry, About content, and navigation into the first public music areas.
text.zhTW: 品牌入口、關於內容與前往第一批公開音樂區域的導覽。

text.en: Homepage content and About were contained in index.html; About was not a separate HTML page.
text.zhTW: 首頁內容與關於皆位於 index.html；關於不是獨立 HTML 頁面。

text.en: The hero identifies Tracks Hub and leads into the public product experience.
text.zhTW: 主視覺識別 Tracks Hub，並引導進入公開產品體驗。

text.en: A Choose your next step section presents the major music tools as direct destinations.
text.zhTW: 「選擇下一步」區段將主要音樂工具呈現為直接目的地。

text.en: Featured audio and Latest Releases surface current track material before the About section.
text.zhTW: 精選音訊與最新發布在關於區之前呈現目前音軌內容。

text.en: The Vue-owned index.html entry presents the hero, tool index, featured track, latest releases, About, shared navigation, metadata, and footer.
text.zhTW: 由 Vue 管理的 index.html 入口呈現主視覺、工具索引、精選音軌、最新發布、關於、共用導覽、中繼資料與頁尾。

text.en: The Homepage runs within the Vue and Vite multi-page frontend while retaining shared theme, localization, navigation, and animation behavior.
text.zhTW: 首頁在 Vue 與 Vite 多頁式前端中運作，同時保留共用主題、在地化、導覽與動畫行為。

text.en: Large editorial sections and multi-card tool/track layouts support scanning across the product range.
text.zhTW: 大型編輯式區段與多卡片工具／音軌版面支援掃讀整體產品。

text.en: Late-July navigation work kept the logo on one line and refined tablet behavior.
text.zhTW: 7 月下旬導覽改善讓標誌維持單行並改善平板行為。

text.en: Cards and sections stack; PR #6 explicitly restored a Homepage regression while refining Song Workspace responsiveness.
text.zhTW: 卡片與區段堆疊；PR #6 在改善歌曲工作區響應式時明確修復首頁回歸。

text.en: The public Homepage and About section entered history with the site foundation.
text.zhTW: 公開首頁與關於區隨網站基礎進入歷史。

text.en: Premium motion and W10–W13 changed the discovery surface.
text.zhTW: 進階動態與 W10–W13 改變探索介面。

text.en: A responsive Song Workspace fix also restored affected Homepage behavior.
text.zhTW: 歌曲工作區響應式修正同時恢復受影響的首頁行為。

text.en: v2.0.5 completed Vue ownership of the Homepage within the Vite multi-page architecture.
text.zhTW: v2.0.5 完成首頁在 Vite 多頁式架構下的 Vue 管理遷移。

text.en: The Homepage is the Vue-owned bilingual public entry at /, combining brand orientation, direct product discovery, W19 featured/recent track content, About, and shared site navigation.
text.zhTW: 首頁目前是由 Vue 管理、位於 / 的雙語公開入口，整合品牌方向、直接產品探索、W19 精選／近期音軌內容、關於與共用網站導覽。

text.en: A discovery page must evolve with both the product catalog and current content, so shared changes require explicit Homepage regression checks.
text.zhTW: 探索頁必須同時隨產品目錄與目前內容演進，因此共用變更需要明確首頁回歸檢查。

text.en: No original wireframe, traffic goal, or documented ordering experiment was found.
text.zhTW: 未找到原始線框圖、流量目標或排序實驗紀錄。
